pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī aññatarissā itthiyā kulūpikā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.3: atha kho sā itthi taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.4: “handayye imaṃ saṅghāṇiṃ amukāya nāma itthiyā dehī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.6: “sacāhaṃ pattena ādāya gamissāmi vissaro me bhavissatīti paṭimuñcitvā agamāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.10: sā bhikkhunī tehi manussehi uppaṇḍiyamānā maṅku ahosi. atha kho sā bhikkhunī upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.11: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
